title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode12 I Warned You

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ready when you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay, girls!
Let's jam!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They're keeping up with me. They must have practiced this song a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (All right, we can do this. After so many sessions with Miku and Luka, we've got this down to a T.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I haven't missed a single note! I just have to keep it up and Shiho will agree to join our band!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Why am I...getting dizzy? Not now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (We're so close. I have to finish the song...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, what's wrong?! Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe... Sorry I didn't say anything...
I think I've worked up a fever...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'll call an ambulance!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No... I'm fine. It's just a cold.
Do you mind if I lie down for a bit?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How are you feeling? Any better?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks.
I just needed a break.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Despite practicing with you every day, I didn't notice you were sick. I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's my fault for making you overwork yourself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, it's nobody's fault but mine for not realizing my limits.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I was having so much fun today that I just didn't want to stop even when I knew I should've.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know what you mean. I'm happy we got to play together today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I thought you hated me, Shiho.
I didn't think we'd get to hang out like this ever again.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I never hated you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tell me, Shiho... What happened while I was in the hospital?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I ended up in a class where I didn't know anyone.
Some girls often asked me to walk home with them, or to eat lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you know I'm not the social type. I don't feel the need to be around other people. So I kept refusing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because of that, my classmates started to avoid me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I had no problem with that. I was glad not to be bothered.
But then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line: This girl from another class comes around to see Hinomori all the time. What's her name? Hoshino? Can you believe Hinomori actually has a friend?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line: I heard they've been friends since elementary. Birds of a feather, huh.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line:
That must be it.
She seemed rude and a bit stand-offish too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line: I can't stand people who think they're too cool for everyone else. Like, they're too special to be friends with you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I snapped at them for saying bad things about my friends behind their backs, but that only made things worse.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Personally, I don't care what they say about me. But I didn't want them to start spreading malicious rumors about Ichika or Honami.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So you decided to cut ties with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why didn't you say anything!?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Because you'd have worried, and then you would've come to talk to me at school.
Those girls would only get nastier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well, thanks for telling us now. It's good to know you didn't totally change and start hating us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You did everything you did because you cared about Ichi and Hona.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, no matter what anyone says, I want to be your friend.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Meh.
I messed it all up anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I really cared about protecting you, I shouldn't have agreed to this session.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So much for self-control.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I warned you, at least. So if you want to keep this going, don't come crying to me later saying you can't hack it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, are you saying you'll...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Join your band, yeah. If that's okay with you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We couldn't be happier to have you! Welcome to the band, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Woohoo! This is huge! Ichi, we got Shiho to join our band! We really did it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe, if we get to have a proper talk with Hona, she'll join us too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's try talking to her again! Wouldn't it be wonderful to all be in the band together again? Uh... Whoah...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki, don't jump around when you're feeling unwell!
Lie back down...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sigh... Saki, first of all, you need to get back in shape. Then we can think about how to get through to Honami together. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All right! Hehe.
